description: This file contains helper functions and test setups for testing bitmap functionality in a Git repository. It includes functions for comparing rev-list outputs, setting up complex repositories with merges for testing bitmaps, and performing various bitmap-related tests.

methods.name: test_bitmap_traversal
methods.description: Compares traversal outputs between bitmap and non-bitmap rev-list results, normalizing and sorting outputs for accurate comparison.

methods.name: setup_bitmap_history
methods.description: Sets up a complex repository history with multiple branches, merges, and tags to test bitmap computations.

methods.name: rev_list_tests_head
methods.description: Runs various rev-list tests with and without bitmap indexing on a specified branch.

methods.name: rev_list_tests
methods.description: Runs a suite of rev-list related tests on a list of branches.

methods.name: basic_bitmap_tests
methods.description: Runs fundamental bitmap tests, including verification and cloning tests, and checks for correct behavior of the bitmap index.

methods.name: have_delta
methods.description: Checks if a specific object is stored as a delta based on its base object.

methods.name: midx_pack_source
methods.description: Determines which pack file a specific object was stored in.

methods.name: test_rev_exists
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a reverse index for a specific commit.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_core
methods.description: Primary test suite for creating and verifying multi-pack indexes with bitmaps, including setup, testing, and cleanup.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_partial_tests
methods.description: Tests for partial bitmap indexes and their correctness with complex repository states.
